about_the_game:
This DLC introduces the player into the world that gave rise to the original conflict depicted in Hardpunch - Sex plague.
The player will go back 3 thousand years in the past and meet the characters responsible for the sexual apocalypse that will come.
Magna Edna discovers that her husband has been kidnapped by alien gods and needs to get rid of the mercenaries that were sent to kill her. She was guided by a gladiator friend to look for the pages of azazel's diary that her husband spread around the couple's Roman palace.
This game contains clues that the heroine needs to find while facing her enemies. All clues correspond to one or more pages in the Diary. The objective is to complete the first level to finally reach the place where Saklas is held hostage.
It won't be an easy mission to handle.
The heroine will basically use swords of various types to knock down her opponents. Most are bloodthirsty gladiators.
They will support alien mercenaries dressed as Roman soldiers.

THE HISTORY
In the past, a mysterious immortal man finally manages to create the first clone of his dead wife. She was murdered a hundred years ago by one of his lovers.
The immortal was successful because he was helped by the same people who gave him immortality: "The astronaut gods".
However, Saklas - the immortal - became an insane leader. He was obsessed with his wife. He named his first clone Magna Edna.
She has grown into an unbelievable and extremely daring woman. Magna Edna was addicted to sex and combat. Over time, it turns out that she has also become immortal! She had her own plans and no one was going to stop her. Neither Saklas nor the astronaut gods.
In the future, the HardPunch heroine lives in a post-apocalyptic world where the goddess Venus is the cult object of the survivors. Humanity has become sterile. Creatures are created in laboratories through genetic engineering. The world has become horrendous, wicked, and extremely dangerous.
What remains of society lives around sexual practices. A nuclear mutation allows some survivors to absorb energy through sex, turning that energy into a lethal weapon. After the nuclear apocalypse, a CULT of followers of the goddess Venus appears.

The GAMEPLAY
Playing is extremely easy because you can use your computer's keyboard and mouse or you can choose a joystick.
Recommendation: Better experience when playing with the keyboard.
This game is for PC Windows and is not heavy to play. The interface offers a lot of gameplay information. In addition, you can count on the help of a complete inventory.
The player explores an open world in the third person. It is necessary to survive until the end. During this challenge, it is important to collect items of all types (health, stamina, bladed weapons, etc.). There are no firearms in this past. Practically the weapons available are swords, knives, and shields.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains sexually explicit scenes (cutscenes, etc). All characters appear naked or with minimal clothing. There is erotic content and systematic exposure of male and female genitals. All characters featured are over 21 years old.
The sexual theme is a main feature of this game. NSFW content.
There is no consumption of drugs or alcohol.
Moderate violence. There is no gore or extreme violence.
